documents.title: Product brief
documents.body: Second Sole is an illustrative peer-to-peer sneaker resale app. Buyers discover, save, negotiate and purchase pairs. Sellers create and manage listings. Conversations and orders retain stable listing identity. The map describes intended behavior; no commerce backend, payment processing, real seller data, or working sneaker app is bundled.

documents.title: Visual direction
documents.body: Preserve the supplied warm ivory, black typography, photographic sneakers, pale grey surfaces, and orange primary actions. Five main destinations: Home, Search, Sell, Inbox, Profile. Keep ScreenAtlas chrome separate from the app design. Original board and full-size supplied screens remain under sources/.

documents.title: Reference provenance
documents.body: Three original supplied PNGs are retained byte for byte: the mood board, My listings, and its action sheet. Eleven standalone screen derivatives were reconstructed with the built-in Image Gen tool from the mood board; these are not exact pixel crops. Six further states extend the same app. Exact prompts and input/output digests are in prompts.json and references.json. None of these images is a real app capture or a recorded reviewer approval.
